acceptance.comparable_salary: Numeric, non-negative salary endpoint(s), salary_period YEAR, and salary_currency USD only.
acceptance.range_scalar: Use numeric salary_max when present; otherwise numeric salary_min. An inverted numeric band is ineligible.
acceptance.unknown_values: Missing, malformed or negative supplied endpoints, inverted bands, hourly, and non-USD salaries sort last in both directions; a missing or JSON-null single endpoint is allowed.
acceptance.tie_break: Comparable equal salaries and all ineligible salaries tie-break by stable job ID.
acceptance.limit: SQL order is applied before result LIMIT.
acceptance.saved_search: Profile-scoped sort selection validates, persists, survives Store reopen, and is restored in the connected UI.
acceptance.side_effects: Sorting does not edit job attributes, match scores, schedule sources, or submit applications.
